answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts?
answers.answer: Per OSM, one underpass with a lift and stairs up to each of the two platforms (the one nearest the station, tracks 1–2, and the far one, tracks 3–4), plus stairs to street level on the station side. No owner source describes them; VR only says the platforms are high with step-free boarding of low-floor trains.
answers._source: OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-TL.json), read 2026-10-30; VR 'Toijala (Akaa)' station page, https://www.vr.fi/rautatieasemat-ja-reitit/toijala, read 2026-10-30; Wikipedia 'Toijala railway station', https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toijala_railway_station, read 2026-10-30

open: Lifts and stairs are OSM only: no VR text, plan or photo checked. Which tracks each platform serves (1–2 / 3–4) is inferred from Digitraffic track spacing and OSM positions.
Whether the east end of the underpass has stairs/lift to street level is not in the extract.
